Madonna - Love Sensation (Promotional Single)

"Love Sensation" is a song by the American singer Madonna. It was released on June 4, 2026, through Warner Records. The song was sent to Italian radio the following day as the second single from her fifteenth studio album, Confessions II (2026). It was written and produced by Madonna and Stuart Price.
